title: Counter Input
text: Read from one or multiple counter-input channels, 2 outputs, {Reset after read} sets Counter-reset policy; {Install new board} sets the register a board < no board, {Delete current board} sets the delete the current board, {Board setup} sets the up the board, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Input channels} selects counter-input channels, {Clock input source} sets the clock input that increments counter input pin rising, {Gate input functionality} sets the action of counter-gate input pin and {Output data type} sets the data type of block. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Counter Data
ports.summary: Counter data read from input channels vector

params.name: Install new board
params.values: Register a board < no board selected > (default)

params.name: Maximum missed ticks
params.values: Number of timer ticks by which your model can trail the kernel 10 (default) | integer

params.name: Show “Missed Ticks” port
params.values: Send number of missed ticks to port Missed Ticks ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Yield CPU when waiting
params.values: Yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Reset after read
params.values: Counter-reset policy never (default) | always | level | rising edge | falling edge | either edge

params.name: Clock input source
params.values: Clock input that increments counter input pin rising edge (default) | input pin falling edge | internal clock

params.name: Gate input functionality
params.values: Action of counter-gate input pin none (default) | enable when high | enable when low | start on rising edge | start on falling edge | reset on rising edge | reset on falling edge | latch on rising edge | latch on falling edge | latch & reset on rising edge | latch & reset on falling edge | enable when high, latch & reset on edge | enable when low, latch & reset on edge

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of block output double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32
